BiblicalUsage: theristḗs stands behind the English phrase a reaper, a harvester. In Matthew 13:30, in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, and it appears again in Matthew 13:39.
TheologicalSignificance: Reapers sent at harvest time tell me God will sort what I cannot, and my job is to grow where He planted me.
